# screenplay-interop

> Original fictional Fountain 1.1 and Final Draft (FDX) files for testing screenplay interchange.

Each fixture includes an input file, expected behavior, a writer-facing
explanation, and an authorship statement. The runner validates the collection
and generates its case catalog. Developers can use the cases in their own
parser, importer, and export tests.

## Read and use

- [Repository](https://github.com/inkwell-app/screenplay-interop): source, setup, and contribution guide.
- [Case catalog](https://github.com/inkwell-app/screenplay-interop/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): fixture expectations and portability classes.
- [Interoperability guide](https://www.inkwell.software/resources/interop): screenplay handoff guidance.
- [FDX Inspector](https://www.inkwell.software/tools/fdx-inspector): inspect a file in the browser.

## Fixture IDs

Stable directories use fixtures/<id>/. See the README catalog for the cases.
The fixture inputs are original fiction licensed under MIT.

## Portability classes

expected_to_transfer
transfers_with_visible_difference
preserved_as_data_with_changed_controls
likely_lossy
unknown
